Druhá část řešení je postavena na open-source technologii identifikované účastníkem zadávacího řízení jako nejvhodnější, dedikována specificky lesnickému oddělení (Forestry Department; „FD“) Ministerstva zelené ekonomiky a životního prostředí, a položí základ pro robustní řešení systematického a technologicky pokročilého sběru dat a tvorbu mapových aj. datových podkladů nutných pro efektivní lesní hospodářské plánování na všech úrovních (národní až distriktní). Novel techniques will be necessary to physically integrate the transmit and/or receive MMIC (Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit) with the beamforming functionality whilst managing the RF and DC interconnectivity and thermal heat dissipation issues that will result from such high integration. For such high frequency applications (V-/W-bands), RF electrical interconnections become critical, and loss should be minimised to maintain system efficiency, therefore the use of flip-chip connections or re-distribution layers, should be investigated. In addition, coupling and parasitic inductances need to be minimised to optimise electrical performance and unit to unit consistency. Careful 3D electromagnetic analysis is required to optimise the advanced RF structure performance. The proposed activity aims to develop new and novel manufacturing, packaging and advanced RF integration techniques which provide improved, highly integrated and repeatable performance for millimetre-wave active array applications. The advanced RF integration technique shall be an alternative to PCB (Printed Circuit Board) assembly technologies and could include, but not be limited to techniques such as 3D microelectronics, Fan Out Wafer Level Packaging (FOWLP), flip-chip/hot-via, antenna-inpackage, micromachining, precision additive manufacturing, etc., thereby demonstrating high performance, high integration, and miniaturisation. A breadboard shall be designed, manufactured and tested to demonstrate the electrical, mechanical and thermal aspects. The breadboard shall target a generic mm-wave application which demonstrates the integration of RF functionality in an advanced RF structure, suitable for an active antenna. Novel interconnection/packaging techniques shall only be considered and novel techniques for thermal management shall be proposed. The following tasks are foreseen in the frame of this activity: Requirements review:o Definition of application and review of requirements.o Initial design requirements identification. o Technology trade-off and down-selection. Breadboard preliminary design:o Initial demonstration of solution to meet fundamental requirements. o Preliminary manufacturing process flow definition. Breadboard detailed design and analysis:o Detailed RF and thermal performance analysis. o If deemed necessary, different test vehicles can be designed to evaluate specific performance parameters.o Detailed manufacturing process flow definition. o Definition of test and verification plan. Breadboard manufacturing and test:o Exercise of manufacturing process flows.o Assemble breadboard demonstrator and/or test vehicles.o Test against verification plan. Results analysis and evaluation.
